method.name: in_memory_text_only_vs_visual_hint_lexical_proxy_v1
method.description: Builds an in-memory text-only corpus from layout candidate textContext and an augmented corpus that appends visual retrieval hints for validated hint rows, then compares target rank for visual-hint-derived probe queries.
limitations: This is not an operational vector-index or answer-quality evaluation.
Probe queries are generated from visual hints, so results estimate potential recall lift rather than real user success.
A later targeted search eval is required before scaling or indexing.
